gloss_en: Leah — the matriarch, wife of Yaakov, understood kabbalistically as the partzuf Leah: the concealed feminine (alma d'itkasya, the hidden world), positioned at the back of the head/neck (oref), the 'first nukva,' associated with the heart and the sweetening of harsh judgments (not the verb לָאָה 'to be weary,' though wordplay with lo'eh occurs)
